shared_elements: low-relief carved curvilinear motifs on a rock surface
clustered, repeated carved forms covering the surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carvings of curved, schematic forms that could be read as crouching creatures or bird-like profiles, which is about as generic a correspondence as carved imagery offers. B presents a highly organised multi-register composition with a row of quadrupeds, a hatched band, a large winged raptor, snakes and a headless figure in explicit spatial relationships, whereas A shows only isolated, ambiguous grooved outlines scattered across natural boulders with no legible scene or register scheme.
